text:
Re-read when memway_search was added. The test's claim is unchanged - every tool the server advertises must be listed here deliberately, so a tool cannot ship undiscoverable. The set gained memway_search.

Worth recording alongside: the serve-loop test asserted a hard-coded count of 10 tools. That is a constant describing behaviour, invisible to a test that checks behaviour (lesson 11) - it fails on every new tool and teaches you to bump the number rather than ask whether the tool is advertised. It now derives from len(mcp.TOOLS).
